system.biography:
Porpoises are mammals that tend to be playful, friendly, and helpful. A typical porpoise is 4 to 6 feet long and weighs 110 to 160 pounds. The statistics presented here can describe any small whale of similar size.

Combat

Blindsight (Ex)

Porpoises can "see" by emitting high-frequency sounds, inaudible to most other creatures, that allow them to locate objects and creatures within 120 feet. A silence spell negates this and forces the porpoise to rely on its vision, which is approximately as good as a human’s.

Hold Breath (Ex)

A porpoise can hold its breath for a number of rounds equal to 6 × its Constitution score before it risks drowning.

Skills

A porpoise has a +8 racial bonus on any Swim check to perform some special action or avoid a hazard. It can always choose to take 10 on a Swim check, even if distracted or endangered. It can use the run action while swimming, provided it swims in a straight line. *A porpoise has a +4 racial bonus on Spot and Listen checks. These bonuses are lost if its blindsight is negated.

Celestial Porpoise

These celestial creatures are commonly summoned by the summon monster I spell.

Combat

Smite Evil (Su)

Once per day a celestial porpoise can make a normal melee attack to deal 2 points of extra damage against an evil foe.

system.description: You are skilled at using light weapons.
system.benefit: With a light weapon, rapier, whip, or spiked chain made for a creature of your size category, you may use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier on attack rolls. If you carry a shield, its armor check penalty applies to your attack rolls.
system.special: Natural weapons are considered light weapons.

system.description: Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
Make a Swim check once per round while you are in the water. Success means you may swim at up to one-half your speed (as a full-round action) or at one-quarter your speed (as a move action).

What it does (SRD): The creature perceives its surroundings without vision out to the distance on each copy, within blindsight limits.

ThirdEra: Canonical template uses a blank range; set distance under CGS parameters and overrides.

What it does (SRD): In starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar dim lighting, the creature can see twice as far as a human can in the same light. It retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under those conditions that a human could not.

ThirdEra: Low-light vision is set on this item’s Details tab under Capability grants (vision and senses), not in Mechanical effects (no extra distance is needed for the usual reading of the rule). The character sheet includes it with other vision from items and race.

Blindsight (Ex): Echo-location to 120 ft. (see embedded blindsight item; silence negates and forces reliance on vision).

Hold Breath (Ex): May hold breath for 6 × Constitution rounds before drowning risk.

Skills (Ex): +8 racial on Swim for special actions/hazards; always take 10; may run in a straight line while swimming. +4 on Spot and Listen while blindsight applies (lost if blindsight is negated).

Celestial porpoise (summoned): Smite Evil (Su) 1/day — +2 damage on one melee hit vs. an evil foe.
